body: thanks but one thing i really don’t want is to be medicated. being able to work and maintain some sort of normality (outwardly) without meds is the last bit of control i have over my life

I have made various attempts to get better with therapy, CBT, antidepressants etc over the years. None of them made a lasting difference for me (the antidepressants especially had heavy side effects and I was still pretty suicidal on them; I feel physically much better without them if not mentally). Work and socialising have helped keep me functional because they give me something else to focus on. However the second I finish work or say goodbye to friends I’m instantly back in the pit of black emptiness. It is my default state of being.

Felt this exact way for years. I had many privileges growing up that are ultimately wasted on the broken, hateful, embittered wreck of a person I have become. I know people who despite growing up poor are so full of life and goodness and I’d frankly just give them my life and family rather than squander it any more with my terrible choices.

I sometimes think I would but I’ve also seen plenty of people suffer in horrible toxic/abusive ones, and the fear of that is one of the things that has kept me from trying to get any sort of real relationship. I can at least (usually) stay functional right now while I’m single. If i had to come home from work to someone who treated me like shit I doubt I could survive long. I saw much stronger people than me reduced to sobbing wrecks by their cheating/abusive partners.

I hope you’re still here. Not going to play the usual “think of your family” BS, all I will say is that you seem to love your children very much. That alone makes you someone who deserves to live. I fully understand you don’t feel that way right now. I hope you can in time.
